rows.label: Total adjustment for risk of wastage
Misappropriation without monitoring results
rows.explainer: We've consistently received comprehensive monitoring results from GiveDirectly. (We chose not to revisit the GiveDirectly's monitoring in 2019 and therefore have not updated this.)

rows.label: False monitoring results
rows.explainer: We have relatively high confidence in GiveDirectly's monitoring, which involves multiple rounds of checks and audits by different teams. (We chose not to revisit the GiveDirectly's monitoring in 2019 and therefore have not updated this.)

rows.label: Total adjustment for quality of monitoring and evaluation
Change of priorities
rows.explainer: Our cost per dollar delivered calculation captures spending on priorities other than delivery of cash transfers.

rows.label: Non-funding bottlenecks
rows.explainer: Has been able to spend funding quickly.

rows.label: Within-org fungibility
rows.explainer: All funds support cash transfer programs, however some programs may be less cost-effective than the program we model in our cost-effectiveness analysis and there may be some fungibility across programs, particularly in how fundraising staff spend their time.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
